== Title ==
<span lang="ja">毛皮の抱擁</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：ルークとチューイーが一緒に戦闘に参加しているなら、戦闘運命数を余分に2枚加えることができる。2：自分の反乱軍とエイリアンが一緒に戦闘に参加しているなら、戦闘力に4を加えることができる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ウーキーは豊かな感情を持ち、家族や友人を護ることで知られている。チューバッカはいつしかルークを自分の家族の一員として扱うようになっていた。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Rug Hug.

'''Lore''' — Wookiees have rich emotions and are known for protecting family and friends. Chewbacca had come to treat Luke as a member of his own family.

'''Game text''' — Choose one. If Luke and Chewie are in a battle together, you may add two extra battle destiny. If you have a Rebel and an alien in a battle together, you may add 4 to power.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Title is 毛皮の抱擁. Game text uses numbered どちらかを選ぶ rather than OR, names チューイー, and omits English “power only”.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-rughug.gif|Original English face]], [[Rug Hug]].</ref>
